locator: Fig. 4, p. 200, the 'Adult' open circle, against the running text on the same page
evidence: The text on p. 200 states 'Density of neurons in layer 3 at age 2 years was about 55% above the adult mean of 1.32 x 10^4 +/- 0.04 S.E.M.'. The adult open circle of Fig. 4 digitises to 1.11 x 10^4 (ordinate calibrated on all six printed ticks, max residual 0.04 x 10^4). The figure is internally consistent with the 55% statement - the 2-year open circle digitises to 1.68 x 10^4, i.e. 52% above the plotted adult value - but not with the printed adult value of 1.32, from which the 2-year value would have to be 2.05 x 10^4. The same page says the 7-year brain was 'about 10% above the adult mean'; the figure gives 24%.
note: The CSV keeps the digitised figure value. This is a text-versus-figure discrepancy inside the publication, not a transcription error; neither side was adjusted.
